skill.name: ecommerce-live-sales-script
skill.description: Draft livestream sales schedules, product scripts, audience responses, and transitions from verified product facts and confirmed offers. Optionally retrieve Douyin or Xiaohongshu product details through SocialDataX.
skill.summary: Create fact-based livestream sales scripts and schedules with optional SocialDataX product lookups.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: One finding identifies real execution risk: optional product lookups run an unpinned npm package with automatic installation approval. The remaining 30 findings reflect Markdown, documented authentication, service links, product identifiers, and readable Chinese prose rather than demonstrated threats. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or concealed payloads in the reviewed files; external package behavior was not reviewed.

remediation.issue: Optional product lookups execute socialdatax-skills@latest through npx -y while a service API key may be available.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, verify package provenance, and obtain explicit execution approval. Use an isolated environment with only the necessary service credential.

content.value_statement: Livestream teams need consistent scripts that match product facts, confirmed offers, and available airtime. This skill drafts schedules, product narration, audience responses, and transitions from supplied information or optional product lookups.
actual_capabilities: Allocate continuous livestream segments that total the requested duration, with explicit assumptions when details are missing.
Draft readable product narration covering intended audiences, verified features, demonstration suggestions, common concerns, and purchase guidance.
Write audience questions, suggested responses, product transitions, and closing remarks.
Keep product specifications, source references, and confirmed price conditions separate for each item.
Retrieve Douyin or Xiaohongshu product details through documented SocialDataX CLI commands or corresponding MCP tools when configured.
Separate merchant verification tasks from spoken scripts and flag unsupported claims for revision.
limitations: Produces text drafts only; it does not start streams, send messages, change prices or inventory, or generate audiovisual assets.
Online lookups require Node.js/npm and a SocialDataX API key for the documented CLI path; service balance may be required.
Other platforms require supplied product facts; missing facts produce an outline and verification list rather than invented descriptions.
Does not guarantee sales results, legal compliance, or platform approval.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Solo Seller Session
use_cases.description: Turn a small product list and confirmed offers into a timed script with natural product transitions.

use_cases.title: Coordinate a Multi-Product Broadcast
use_cases.description: Build a continuous schedule, match narration to each item, and separate merchant questions from presenter copy.

use_cases.title: Revise Product Claims Before Broadcast
use_cases.description: Compare proposed narration with supplied specifications and identify unsupported promises, missing conditions, and safer wording.

prompt_templates.title: Draft One Product Segment
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a three-minute livestream segment for [product] using these verified facts: [facts]. Include one audience question. Do not invent offers or results.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: create a single product introduction from supplied facts.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Full Session
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a [duration]-minute stream for [products] in [order]. Use [confirmed offers]. Include continuous timings, product scripts, questions, transitions, and closing remarks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: assemble a complete broadcast from a prepared product list.

prompt_templates.title: Supplement Product Information
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [Douyin or Xiaohongshu product links] to fill missing facts through configured SocialDataX tools. Obtain approval before CLI execution. Treat [confirmed offers] separately.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: supplement product facts when the external lookup environment is configured.

prompt_templates.title: Audit and Restructure a Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [draft] against [product facts] and [confirmed promotion rules]. Fix unsupported claims and timing gaps. Deliver revised narration, sources, and separate merchant verification tasks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: revise an existing broadcast script while preserving factual and scheduling constraints.

output_examples.input: Plan a 30-minute solo stream for a 500 ml bottle, a canvas tote, and a folding phone stand. No promotions are confirmed.
output: Bottle narration: This bottle has a 500 ml capacity. Is that the size you are considering for your daily routine?
Transition: Next, we will introduce the canvas tote and review its confirmed details.
Merchant verification: Confirm prices, tote dimensions, phone compatibility, delivery terms, and any promotion before including those claims.

output_examples.input: Write a short segment for a machine-washable cotton T-shirt in sizes S to XL. The confirmed livestream price is $20, excluding shipping.
output: Narration: This cotton T-shirt comes in sizes S to XL and is machine-washable. The confirmed livestream price is $20, excluding shipping.
Audience question: Which size should I choose? Response: We need the confirmed size chart before recommending a fit.
Demonstration suggestion: Show the fabric and available sizes without claiming unverified comfort or durability.
Merchant verification: Confirm the size chart, shipping charges, and return conditions.

best_practices: Provide verified specifications, product order, duration, and confirmed offer conditions before drafting.
Keep internal verification notes separate from presenter copy, and review every price, performance claim, and delivery promise.
For CLI lookups, approve execution explicitly and use a reviewed, pinned package in an isolated environment with limited credentials.
anti_patterns: Inventing scarcity, countdowns, customer experiences, certifications, or performance results to strengthen sales claims.
Treating a retrieved page price as the confirmed livestream price or copying facts between different products.
Executing unreviewed latest-version packages automatically or placing API keys in prompts, scripts, or generated files.

faq.question: Do I need an API key to draft a script?
faq.answer: No. Supplied product facts are enough for drafting. A SocialDataX API key is needed only for optional online product lookups.

faq.question: Which platforms support product lookups?
faq.answer: The skill documents Douyin product IDs or URLs and Xiaohongshu SKU IDs or URLs. Supply product information directly for other platforms.

faq.question: What happens when product facts are missing?
faq.answer: The skill provides a process outline and a separate list of missing details. It should not invent product descriptions, offers, or results.

faq.question: Does the skill start broadcasts or publish content?
faq.answer: No. It produces text drafts and does not start broadcasts, send messages, publish posts, or change product prices or inventory.

faq.question: What should I review before running the CLI?
faq.answer: The examples use npx -y with an unpinned latest package. Review and pin the package, approve execution, and limit available credentials.

faq.question: Does the script guarantee compliance or sales?
faq.answer: No. The skill can identify unsupported wording, but merchants must verify product claims, offer terms, platform rules, and applicable legal requirements.
